material.name: Ilford Multigrade FB Classic · filter 2
material.model: One fixed-filter neutral total reflection-density response; no measured surface, paper-white or image-tone spectrum.

publication: ILFORD MULTIGRADE FB CLASSIC Technical Information, October 2013, Japanese manufacturer edition

conditions.surface: Publication covers 1K glossy and 5K matt; characteristic plot does not separately identify its surface or drying geometry
conditions.exposure_axis: relative exposure abscissa interpreted as log10 exposure, as used by the characteristic/ISO-range convention; arbitrary relative origin retained
conditions.density: one total reflection density as plotted, no extra base
conditions.toning: untoned characteristic curve; no selenium/other toner added
conditions.endpoint: constant numerical extension outside the published plotted curve; no common black/white adjustment

source_vector.reconstruction_grid: 257 uniform log-exposure knots sampled from digitized vector centerline
source_vector.curve_identification: cyan stroke (CMYK0.547/0/0.176/0) labelled 2 in the upper characteristic graph, including separate toe and shoulder stroke fragments52–62; centerline clipped to the plot rectangle; not adjacent green1 or red3
